$comment: Homelab service directory for site/app/homelab/page.tsx. These are self-hosted apps reverse-proxied by this VPS's Nginx Proxy Manager (outside this repo, see /opt/app/homelab) and reachable only over Tailscale — no public port. Cross-referenced against `docker ps` on 2026-08-21, not just NPM's saved config (two stale entries, vault.egolab.top and n8n.egolab.top, had no running container behind them and were dropped). Live online/offline status is supplied separately by the homelab-status sidecar, matched to entries here by `subdomain`.
